None is about dwellings. eCode360 is Cloudflare-walled for plain fetches. Text was read in a browser, mostly from the print view of the whole chapter.
provenance.code_current_through_note: Includes legislation through 05-27-2026. New Laws (3) not yet codified.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law or accessory apartment provision
AR, CR, R-1 and R-2 allow 'One single-family detached dwelling' by right (27-302, 27-404, 27-405, 27-406)
Detached garages, barns and similar buildings may not be used 'for habitation' (27-1105.2C). Gazebos, pool houses and similar structures may not be 'permanent living quarters' (27-1105.5E)
A dwelling unit is used by one family. Family means relatives, or not more than five unrelated persons, with single cooking facilities (27-201)
Two-family dwellings (twin house, duplex) are dwelling types in the R-3 Multi-Family Residential District (27-407). It is the closest two-unit option, not an ADU path

Detached accessory buildings on lots up to two acres: max 1,000 sq ft footprint and never larger than the house footprint, 15 ft high, 15 ft side and rear setbacks (10 ft side in an R-2 cluster subdivision). One detached garage, barn or similar per lot, two above two acres (27-1105.2A, 2B, 2D)
R-2 lot area is per dwelling unit: 20,000 sq ft (27-406.2A(1))
A leased dwelling needs a tenant registration from the Township before occupancy. Owners report tenants each year (Chapter 11, 11-302)

status.note: The code has no ADU text. 27-1105.2C bars habitation in detached garages and similar buildings. That rules out a detached ADU but does not name ADUs.

path.note: Reading: a second unit is not a listed use. R-1 and R-2 allow 'One single-family detached dwelling'. The path is a use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board.

fallback_path.note: Same as path. A detached unit also needs relief from 27-1105.2C, which bars habitation in detached accessory buildings.

zoning_districts.note: No district lists an ADU. Reading of a silent code.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path.

value.condition: Detached garages, barns and similar may not be used 'for habitation'. Gazebos, pool houses and similar may not be 'permanent living quarters'.
One detached residential garage, barn, carport or similar per lot (two above two acres). Footprint never larger than the house or 1,000 sq ft up to two acres.
A leased dwelling needs a tenant registration from the Township. Owners report tenants each year.

types_allowed.note: No ADU form is listed. Detached accessory buildings may not be used for habitation.

max_height_ft.note: 'The maximum height of any accessory building or structure shall be 15 feet unless otherwise indicated.' Lots over two acres: 20 ft for garages and barns.

setback_front_ft.note: 'The accessory building, structure or use shall not be located in the front yard.'

setback_side_ft.note: Detached garages and similar, lots up to two acres: 'The required side and rear yard setbacks are both 15 feet each.' 20 ft for 2 to 5 acres, 30 ft above.

setback_rear_ft.note: 15 ft on lots up to two acres. 20 ft for 2 to 5 acres, 30 ft above.

accessory_structure_max_sqft.note: 'A maximum of 1,000 square feet is permitted for properties up to two acres'. Never larger than the house footprint (2D).

separation_ft.note: No separation between buildings on one lot found in 27-1105.

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A dwelling unit is for one family.

max_adus.note: Reading: no ADU is allowed by right.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. 'Residential / 2 per dwelling unit'. The count for a second unit is in parking.reading.

reading.value: Residential: 2 spaces per dwelling unit. A house needs 2. If a second unit were approved it would count as a dwelling unit, so 4 in total.

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached. Principal yards: front 50 ft, each side 30 ft, rear 50 ft. Max impervious surface ratio 20%.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. Accessory buildings may not be in the front yard (27-1105.1B).

max_building_coverage.note: Accessory building area counts toward building coverage (27-1105.1C).

principal_max_height_ft.note: Maximum building height 35 ft, structure height 50 ft.

setback_side_ft.note: 'Side, each: 30 feet.' Single-family detached principal yard. Accessory buildings: 15 ft (envelope).

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached. Principal yards: front 50 ft, side minimum 20 ft, total 45 ft, rear 50 ft. Max impervious surface ratio 20%.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. Accessory buildings may not be in the front yard (27-1105.1B).

max_building_coverage.note: Accessory building area counts toward building coverage (27-1105.1C).

principal_max_height_ft.note: Maximum building height 35 ft, structure height 50 ft.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: 'Minimum lot area per dwelling unit: 20,000 square feet' under 'A. Single-family detached dwellings'. Reading: a second unit would also need 20,000 sq ft, so 40,000 in total. The code allows no ADU, so this is shown as a condition.

setback_side_ft.note: 'Side, minimum 20 feet, total, 45 feet.' Single-family detached principal yard. Accessory buildings: 15 ft (envelope).
